### Common Dosing Approaches

- **General / Daily Use:** Most supplement guidelines and small clinical trials use **300 mg to 1,000 mg daily** (such as 150 mg taken twice daily). Many sources advise staying at or below **1,000 mg per day** unless directed otherwise.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1_QdqmTF0VFzVYlwHAsfAl8Hr8DmMfs5FCEI7PoGYPWyvman5T2r8PIoi6bnARv01zmKmL_OdptUAiQ5mnoS_QMnK4ye85wvq7IifC3xanl91zwY2mD_ZYxUqP-gE-bZkOg5nQ9Z_KRjPYbP_Y-t5MKjoeG92gXv_3j-M4zGGAVmkWl8NHt34jaKfw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXk0vGIqQX7MzKSc5japqzKqbA-nQ_kYSSyaflu3VlNzaFiFP1bVgqNQVIDlFsbAnbS6aqgkQvPtdIwPJwm7Y-KAo7vVaFbmLZHW2uWN3oZ8ZX7duaaVJhZpVaLSNg1sXBpb-VJ04)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXCm9yeYRljO-oCnVIpCaJJ-Ai6J4h0cvLY_IMl3YgtaYo26dE15tgBcuIre5-Ojfw1t-54HE9N8GP28j4xqyyMzob2LBiPHwgzxqxfX7hb_Eedj80shvowcT1sZxkBPNg5DnDWhuM)

### Safety & Context

- **Limited Clinical Evidence:** Human clinical trials on DHM are still limited, and DHM is sold as a dietary supplement rather than an FDA-approved drug for treating or preventing medical conditions. The [LiverTox database](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXk0vGIqQX7MzKSc5japqzKqbA-nQ_kYSSyaflu3VlNzaFiFP1bVgqNQVIDlFsbAnbS6aqgkQvPtdIwPJwm7Y-KAo7vVaFbmLZHW2uWN3oZ8ZX7duaaVJhZpVaLSNg1sXBpb-VJ04) notes that short-term human studies have generally reported few adverse effects, though long-term safety and optimal dosing remain under study.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXTxSwnHP5woahnc93ZKhqI_bj2TXS5XpVcv_L7BAhsyIkJz3Y1nBmn1YeJhuXiRGRINeh0bmanbiookPPEljHzCBW0DfTziWtXSaGVNeIJcJMl5IJ8Bix6wYHc3KpCF6YFVIjYw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXk0vGIqQX7MzKSc5japqzKqbA-nQ_kYSSyaflu3VlNzaFiFP1bVgqNQVIDlFsbAnbS6aqgkQvPtdIwPJwm7Y-KAo7vVaFbmLZHW2uWN3oZ8ZX7duaaVJhZpVaLSNg1sXBpb-VJ04)
- **Medical Precautions:** Talk with a healthcare professional before taking DHM if you have liver issues, take medications (potential enzyme/drug interactions have been noted), or are pregnant or breastfeeding.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXKM5svLVFsbZzdj43cQuw3NnvmF7tfhRyd3D7bL-fqEyH8Ibide61JkHCDXr6eYC1shDpzGSpVMowaDIlbfuJWRH2Wr4lsXf46MPBqtoJbJryMMMncmDb6tVeteEPmk-mPwXPjYfurgRzgjw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1_QdqmTF0VFzVYlwHAsfAl8Hr8DmMfs5FCEI7PoGYPWyvman5T2r8PIoi6bnARv01zmKmL_OdptUAiQ5mnoS_QMnK4ye85wvq7IifC3xanl91zwY2mD_ZYxUqP-gE-bZkOg5nQ9Z_KRjPYbP_Y-t5MKjoeG92gXv_3j-M4zGGAVmkWl8NHt34jaKfw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXIECU9w9-ypvg2KVn2japLudtMZoTc85ZKpQ1kWxfNdmY7uOk88Tee1ta_A-rR8TmMRDEGXbCrn4wH_bwTnSr7AHfZe1ak17Vaui2ViVQnih_5ZF4F-ZnG8bNEPLx_-Z3G5W63Axd0oVOelCLVT_RdMCttqJH22FPDw)
